findings.description: The wide best-test label intersects the declining train/test curves near k2–3. Native94.600s sourceframe1419 confirms line across first words; persists94.6–115.9s selected holds.
Copied equation passes across explanatory line at166.533s; moving row copy overlaps source glyphs at180.666 and185.733s. Resolved at end of transition. No continuous playback perceptual assessment.

method: Every selected frame was visually inspected in chronological contact sheets at original sheet resolution. All330 pages were actually viewed; no duplicate-only inference was used. Eight suspect frames were additionally viewed at native854x480. Contact sheets show8 frames at640px thumbnail width, downsampled from854px native width.
coverage_limits: Selected-frame inspection is not continuous perceptual playback. Unextracted source frames remain unviewed, with exact gaps preserved per case.
Maximum selected-time gap is1 second; motion-onset/midpoint/dense/endpoint frames supplement that bound, without guaranteeing capture of every transient.
Source movies are silent480p15 previews; narrated timing, audio/listening/synchronization, final1080p output, player/responsive behavior were not assessed.
Original render broad fingerprints are stale. These results apply only to the exact movie hashes recorded here, not current whole-repository approval.

Current relevant source hashes are a completion-time snapshot only; original render results did not record per-file source hashes. Original input file size/mtime signatures and render fingerprint are retained.
